meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把品牌宣传片、混剪、标题卡和较长的多场景片段做成完整成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有一段或多段素材需要剪成完整的多场景视频成片。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to assemble longer, multi-scene videos from existing footage.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 HyperFrames 流程编导和剪辑自定义视频合成:先经 /hyperframes 定流程、写 BRIEF.md,再读素材与动效参考,逐场景推进到 STORYBOARD.md 和渲染。
howto.when: 当没有专用工作流适用、BRIEF.md 把 flow 设为 companion,或你要做多场景长片、品牌/宣传片、蒙太奇、静态循环、标题卡等时,它会接管。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude authors or edits a custom HyperFrames composition: it routes through /hyperframes, writes BRIEF.md, loads media and animation references, then builds scenes into STORYBOARD.md and renders.
howto.when_en: Triggered when no specialized workflow fits, BRIEF.md sets flow: companion, or you need multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, static loops, or title cards.

say_en.text: Make me a 30-second brand sizzle reel.
